joint: mean(PairAcc AND VSA) over all 300 pairs in each task
tau: Existing per-case t_ref; use unique original frame_span containing tau, no temporal tolerance
auc: Original pair-normalized mean errors, epsilon=1e-12; pooled ROC AUC, ties=0.5
mae: Original conditional MAE on PairAcc-correct and detected cases; original two-frame positive run
ranking: Replace old JointHit with new Joint accuracy; retain tie-breaks PairAcc, AUC, lower original conditional MAE, native on exact tie, then configuration ID
effective_method: c=mean(history); R=max||history-c||2; beta=eta*max(0,1-alpha*R/||y-c||2); a=(1-beta)*y+beta*c; D=0 => beta=0.
matching_baseline: Matched uncorrected predictions from the same native execution/scoring path. Early archival baseline retained separately.
native_temporal_scope: V-JEPA ViT-G/ViT-L and VideoMAE errors cover two-frame tubelets; VSA uses the span containing tau, not an independently scored single video frame.
dino: Original adapter temporal-alignment issue retained; diagnostic, not validated physical improvement.
parameter_reporting: All eta, radius multiplier, visibility thresholds, minimum reliable history count, and insertion position disclosed per actual setting.
